title: Zesty Crunchy Mediterranean Chwinamul Salad
description: A resinous, crunchy lazy-sunday Mediterranean dish featuring chwinamul, finished in a bamboo steamer papillote for a light yet flavorful salad.
instructions: Wash and chop 200g of chwinamul and place in a parchment cup.
Add sliced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, pitted olives, crumbled feta, and thinly sliced onion on top.
Drizzle with 30ml lemon juice, 20ml olive oil, and sprinkle salt, pepper, oregano, and pine nuts.
Cover the cup with parchment and place it in a bamboo steamer set over boiling water.
Steam for 8 minutes until the herbs soften slightly and the flavors meld.
Remove from steamer, let cool a minute, then fluff gently with a fork before serving.
Serve warm or at room temperature on a rustic plate.
